title: Oscar and the Orbit
author: Coral Sterling
blurb: Coral Almeida, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the jump window closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
